Flexbox vs Grid
Flexbox is primarily one-dimensional; Grid is designed for two-dimensional alignment.
Flexbox එක row එකකේ Jහහෝ column එකකේ තුළ items align කරන්න Jහාඳයි. Grid එක rows සහ columns
එකට align කරන්න Jහාඳයි. එකම page එJකේ Jදකම භාවිත කළ හුකියි.
Use Grid for product cards and Flexbox for each card's buttons.

Read the diagram: Compare wrapped flex rows with shared grid tracks: grid aligns columns across rows.
Flex rows වල widths ස්වාධීනයි. Grid එJකේ හුම row එJකේම column boundaries එකට align Jවනවා.
Expected result: Cards line up in columns; buttons sit in a flexible row.
Interview question: When would you choose Grid instead of Flexbox?
Answer: When row and column alignment must be controlled together.
Remember: Flex = one axis; Grid = two axes.
Practice: Make a card grid and use flex inside a card.
